notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
description:
Cast Ember Island Production by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Ember Island Production, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Ember Island Production, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
